set.pl: Stout land, N sec 31 and NW sec 32 T76N R26W, directly S of Patterson (1912 plat); the sugar camp itself not named
pinev: 1910 census: Butler B. Stout, Crawford Twp, Madison Co (the township that holds Patterson); W. A. Maulsby not indexed. No Madison Co plat on Ancestry (its '1901 Madison' set is Marshall Co).

1912 Madison Co atlas, Crawford Twp: R. F. Stout et al 65 a. N sec 31 and C. A. Stout 40 a. NW sec 32 T76N R26W, directly S of Patterson. B. W. Stout was one of the two 1907 diggers (1910 census, Crawford Twp), so the family land is the best candidate for the 'old sugar camp near here'; no Maulsby land on the plate. Candidate placement, not a located spot.

tw-ia-patterson-sugar-camp-1907.t: Look for the old maple grove on the creek bottom inside the Stout tracts on the 1930s air photo.
src: Atlas of Madison County, Iowa (1912), Crawford Twp plate (archive.org, leaf 28)
